omittedResponsibilities: Merged layout paragraphs, unrepresented stories such as footnotes, formatting and regular-expression search, full option configuration and native wait/threshold interactions.
preservedResponsibilities: Connects the represented SwView search command branches to actual Writer cursor ranges, search options and document history. Uses actual body, connected editable text-frame, and active header/footer ranges for text and paragraph-style search and replacement.

Uses the native SvxSearchCmd enum. Initializes the dialog with the expanded single-paragraph cursor text or scopes it to the selection. Find Bar uses the Writer ASCII range writer with numbering and trailing paragraph breaks disabled and refreshes the search entry on focus from the editor.
Projects the represented read-only Writer view state to the replacement controls and applies the same admission to fresh and repeated replacement dispatch.

Searches the actual selected cursor ring to validate a single replacement. Backward Replace discards the stack copy and exchanges the live result endpoints before continuing; Replace All restores the registered cursor. A saved table cursor regenerates its box selection after the text edits.

Tracks the body and extra-area phases across single commands, resets the phase on bulk commands, and uses the pre-normalization document boundary and resulting cursor position in wrap feedback (WRITER-688 and WRITER-689). Uses the native wrap path for selection-only search, including the extra-area flag transition and restored cursor, and keeps the prior command after a zero-result Replace All (WRITER-690 and WRITER-691).
Uses the application data language for search, the explicit native algorithm identity and both selection flags. Find passes and single replacement validation use an empty replacement field.

Single regex Replace resolves capture references on the displayed selection before revalidation, preserves the replacement template for subsequent commands, and propagates the regex flag for plain and formatted replacement.
The modeless dialog and search request expose the regular-expression algorithm and preserve the native IsUseRegularExpression preference.

Uses the visible paragraph stylesheet pool for style controls. Hidden styles remain listed while used, and hidden favourite built-in styles remain available on the replacement side (WRITER-694). Resolves existing and pool style names and preserves the native missing-template fallbacks (WRITER-693).

Uses the existing table, row, cell and text fly content-protection owners for search replacement admission. Find includes protected matches under the native cursor-in-protected-area default. A style Replace All request with no replacement collection still uses the find-only admission.

The view-shell ExecuteSearch slot supplies the represented SearchItem command and direction to this owner. Quiet requests suppress miss and bulk count labels while retaining the search result and repeat state. SearchOn makes the next StateSearch query initialize from the native selection; SearchProperties and SearchOff retain the dispatched dialog settings.
Overrides search direction temporarily for the Navigator repeat action.
